subject: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — L5 hybrid IC/Manager offer
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — L5 hybrid IC/Manager offer

Team —

Following yesterday's debrief with the interview panel, I'm proposing a band-bridge offer to hire Alex Morgan into a hybrid role that mixes senior IC scope with a small team lead expectation. Summary:

- Proposed base: $190,000 (aligns to upper L5 range)
- Target title: L5 Senior Software Engineer (Manager track optional after 6 months)
- Equity: 0.40% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $20k one-time
- Rationale: Alex has deep infra + product experience that matches stripe of L6 work, but wants to avoid a formal manager title initially. We can structure a "band-bridge" offer that puts compensation and equity near strong L5/L6 midpoint while keeping the title L5.

Attached is the draft "band_bridge_proposal_v1.pdf" with comparable bands and a short market comp snapshot. I need two things from this thread:
1) Quick comp approval to finalize the offer by EOD Monday (candidate has two other late-stage offers).
2) Headcount confirmation that we can convert this req to a hybrid-manager designation post-hire (Marissa, Hannah — are we good on HC pool?).

If we can't approve the bridge, we should be explicit in the offer letter about timing/criteria for formal manager conversion.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Infrastructure Platform
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: band_bridge_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — L5 hybrid IC/Manager offer

Jordan —

Thanks for the write-up. A few clarifying questions before I sign off: 
- Is the $190k base tied to any performance milestones for the manager transition, or purely time-based?
- Who owns the conversion criteria (expectations / minimum signals)? We should avoid open-ended manager conversions that create precedent.
- Please confirm total OTE and how this looks across the band (comp sheet would help).

I can provisionally approve the comp if we: (1) add a 6-month review clause with measurable outcomes for leadership behavior, and (2) document that title changes require HC re-approval and final sign-off from People + My org.

Cc'ing Soojin for calibration on offer language and Marissa for HC availability.

- Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — L5 hybrid IC/Manager offer

Quick update on headcount: per the HC tracker I can release one headcount from our infra hiring pool and convert REQ-3321 to a "hybrid" designation for a 6-month probationary manager pathway. Link: https://intra.redwood.com/hc/headcount/REQ-3321

Action items for Jordan: please append the 6-month review milestones that Laura mentioned (deliverables + leadership signals). I'll mark the req status to PENDING-OFFER so TalentOps can push the letter once comp is finalized.

Attachments: headcount_screencap (attached)

- Marissa
Senior Director, Talent Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@gmail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenhouse TalentOps <talentops@greenhouse.io>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — quick clarification

Hi Jordan —

Really appreciate the update and the team's flexibility. One quick question for clarity before I sign the LOI: will the initial offer explicitly state the title as "L5 Senior Software Engineer" with the language about a manager pathway at 6 months? Or will the letter say "L5 (manager-track)"? I care about both the compensation alignment and clarity for external resume positioning.

Also, is the 6-month review criterion public so I can review the expectations?

Thanks — Alex

[Attachment: candidate_resume_alex_morgan.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Band-bridge proposal for Alex Morgan — final approval

All —

I'm good to approve the proposed comp structure with the following non-negotiables: 
1) Offer letter must use the explicit title "L5 Senior Software Engineer" (no parenthetical manager label).
2) Include a short appendix outlining the 6-month leadership review criteria (we'll work with People to make this concise and measurable).
3) Equity and sign-on as proposed are approved.
4) Headcount will remain in infra pool; conversion to formal manager title requires a separate HC submission and final sign-off.

Jordan — you have approval to proceed. Please ask TalentOps to send the LOI with the appendix and mark the req as PENDING-OFFER (Marissa confirmed HC).

— Hannah
VP, Engineering (Infrastructure)
Redwood Inference
